name: Explain computer graphics and 3D rendering concepts
description: Users asked for explanations of concepts and code related to computer graphics, 3D rendering, and shader programming. These requests covered a wide range of topics, including graphics API functionalities in OpenGL and Vulkan, rendering pipeline stages, texture techniques, and 3D model processing, with some instances involving hardware-specific libraries or data visualization tools.
